item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00072","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C08","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a material land-protection proclamation template: recitals identify the lands and public-interest justification; the operative clause invokes a specific conservation statute and reserves following-described lands for a protected federal area; a detailed legal description follows; and a warning provision prohibits harmful or unauthorized conduct. The child adapts that same sequence and machinery to establish a wildlife sanctuary under a different statute. C08 has a somewhat similar statutory-recommendation-and-proclamation structure but concerns listed munitions rather than protected land. C07 shares detailed boundary-description machinery and a public-interest recital, but it restores land by executive order rather than creating and regulating a protected area.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas it appears that the establishment of such sanctuary and refuge would be in the public interest","parent_excerpt":"Whereas it appears that the public interest would be promoted by adding such lands ... to the Fort Matanzas National Monument","explanation":"Both frame protection of specifically identified federal lands as serving the public interest."},{"child_excerpt":"under and by virtue of the authority vested in me by the aforesaid act ... do proclaim that ... all of the lands ... in the following-described area ... are hereby established as a game sanctuary and refuge","parent_excerpt":"under and by virtue of the authority vested in me by section 2 of the act ... do proclaim that ... the following-described lands in Florida are hereby added to and reserved as a part of the Fort Matanzas National Monument","explanation":"The operative provisions use the same statutory land-reservation mechanism followed by a legal description, adapted from monument enlargement to wildlife-preserve establishment."},{"child_excerpt":"All persons are hereby informed that it is unlawful to hunt, catch, trap, willfully disturb, or kill","parent_excerpt":"Warning is hereby expressly given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, deface, or remove any feature of this monument","explanation":"Each follows the land designation with a conduct-warning provision tailored to the protected area's purpose."}]}
